title: Recover Your Download Access | LegalCostGuides
description: Get back to your planning kit downloads with your checkout email and order code.
body:
Enter the email you used at checkout and either your order code (shown on your download page, it looks like LCG-XXXX-XXXX) or the receipt number from the payment receipt emailed by Stripe.

Can't find either? Email javiperezguides@gmail.com from the address you used at checkout and we will send you your link.
